Tihar Prison to Respond to US National's 'American Diet' Plea

Tihar prison authorities have been directed to respond to a plea by a US national, accused of terror-related charges, requesting an 'American-style diet'. The request, according to the accused's counsel, is based on humanitarian grounds and aims to safeguard the client's health during judicial custody. The court will consider the response before making a decision.
